entities.summary: Alya Rohali is an Indonesian film and soap opera actress, television show host, notary, model and a beauty pageant titleholder, who was crowned Puteri Indonesia 1996. She represented Indonesia at the Miss Universe 1996 pageant. She was the first person to hold the title of Puteri Indonesia to hold the title for four consecutive years.
